Publishers sue Brave over AI scraping and paywall bypass

• Brave is sued for building a 30 billion-page index and selling it to AI firms while its paywall blocker bypasses publisher restrictions.
• Anthropic warns its AI research may soon achieve recursive self-improvement, outpacing safety controls.
• Apple targets a $1,000 mobile robot for FaceTime calls and automatic lighting by 2027.

items.text:
New York Times sues Brave for stealing billions of articles to feed AI firms.

• Brave’s pay-wall blocker let users read articles while selling an index to AI firms.
• The index covers over 30 billion pages, too large for publishers to block.

Your take: Should browsers be allowed to sell your reads? Tell us in the comments.

Oracle launches a $20 billion fundraise to power its AI buildout, shaking its stock.

• Shares dropped 8.8% after the plan, despite a $225 billion revenue forecast.
